title: Builders Program Application - Blockexplorer and Wallet
body:
## **Project Overview**

The proposal is to set up, host and maintain a customized block explorer for Edgeware network.

**Project Features**
**Block Explorer**
- Blockchain data
- View blocks
- View accounts (balances, transactions, transfers, tokens, history)
- View contracts
- View tokens (view token contract, view token instance, token transfers, token holders)
- View receipts
- View transactions
- View internal transactions
- View logs
- Block Reorganizations
- ERC-20 token support
- ERC-721 token support
- ERC-1155 token support
- Contract Verification
- Sourcify support
- Query Contract
- Real-time UI, infinite scrolls for data views
- Public labels
- API
- GraphQL
- Download data as CSV

Extra features 
- Hybrid Explorer - EdgeWASM+EdgeEVM Support
- Full node deployment with high performance RPC endpoints.


## **Execution Timeline**

**Start time**
Once this grant submission is successful, the team will be ready to start working immediately.

**Total Estimated Duration**
Phase One (Preparations) – 2 weeks
- Design visual customization.
- Implementation of customization.


Phase Two (Deployment) –  2 weeks
- Deployment
- Troubleshooting and adjustments


## **Funding & Disbursement**

- The amount to be funded to the grantee is $20,000 (USD) of crypto currency with Edgeware, also known as EDG, which will be paid in 3 tranches  - 

               30% prepayment
               40% after Block Explorer, Chrome Wallet and Android Wallet release
               30% after IDO launchpad integration 
             
- We are planning to give back to all contributors in the form of a new token or our main project token after exchange listing.



## **Future Plans​**

FINN is a Hybrid DEX model, where the order book and matching engine is stored on a centralized server while the funds and transactions are recorded on the blockchain.
